author: 1337isnot1337, with OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: Explicit even-dimensional oriented hypercube sparse quadratic systems retain Omega(n log log n) injective scalar-lift index bits under invertible row bases. Every cyclic order and residual spanning basis has span Omega(n/log n) after o(n/log n) substitutions. A bipartite exact count uses 2^(n/2) poly(n) time. No SAT lower bound or improved general algorithm.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the written all-size argument
Coefficientwise support after substitutions and cyclic span through the full high-incidence branch allowance are not covered
General aggregation and alternative algorithms not excluded
No improved all-input SAT bound or alpha
